Statement.description: The xAPI 1.0.3 statement as stored, with its id, stored, authority, version and timestamp. It is validated, and it is not changed.

Voided.description: Whether a voiding statement voided it.

ClientId.description: The OpenID client id that stored it, if a client did.

AuthorityKey.description: The key of the credential that stored it, which read-own access compares.

Statements.description: The statements to add. A statement already on the site is skipped when it is the same, and reported when it differs.
